exposure: Respectful Maternity Care (RMC) during childbirth experiences
outcome: Mothers' perceptions and values of childbirth experiences
Components of appreciated care (compassionate care, emotional support, autonomy, timely care, privacy, supportive environment)
cohort: 30 mothers who reported receiving respectful care during labor and childbirth in five hospitals in the Eastern Province of Rwanda.
finding: Mothers appreciated and were satisfied with compassionate, empathetic, dignified, and timely care from dedicated healthcare providers, highlighting key aspects of respectful maternity care that could be maintained and promoted.
cross-section timing: N/A (The study explored perceptions of experiences during mothers' most recent labor and delivery; the specific timing of data collection post-birth is not mentioned.)
